questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Melbourne has a rental crisis at the moment, which makes it very difficult to find accommodation. I was lucky to find an apartment through a Facebook site. The On campus accommodation is located a bit out of the city center, which is why I chose to find something myself.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: On one hand it can be more expensive and there are a lot of scammers out there so be carefull. On the other hand you get the chance to live closer to the city center.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The academic level was lower than back home, but the workload during the semester was a bit time consuming due to weekly quizzes (not that difficult), pre lectures and exams during the semester.

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The academic level was lower than back home, but the workload during the semester was a bit time consuming due to weekly quizzes (not that difficult), pre lectures and exams during the semester.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Way more teaching in smaller groups in the classroom compared with UCPH. More exams during the semester instead of in the end of the semester. Less self study than at KU. More weekly quizzes and pre lectures.

questions.answer: The nature of Australia. It is outstanding!

questions.answer: Very easy, since the culture is very similar.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Go to the events. It is a very good opportunity of meeting fellow students.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Australians are so openminded and friendly.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Save up money. 
2) Be open to new people and activities in the beginning of your stay (attend all of the events the university offers) 
3) Enjoy the stunning nature of Australia.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware of scammers when renting a place to live. There is so much scamming out there.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: I can't choose, I had so many fantastic experiences. GO GO GO.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Jetlag... and the fact that it is very expensive to live in Australia.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Go go go! You will not regret!
